alate: Alate: head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown with the base paler, antennae yellow, compound eyes black, the markings on the inner side in front of the ocelli rather indistinct and distinctly paler than the head, the margin of the pronotum dull yellow and the disc pale yellow, wing scales deep yellow, meso- and metathorax and abdomen pale yellow. The long hairs of the head evenly distributed, the short hairs sparse, the dorsum of the pronotum rather densely haired and bearing long hairs, the wing membrane rather densely haired.
soldier: Soldier dimorphic. Head brownish yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pronotum paler than the head, meso- and metathorax and abdomen nearly milky white. The pilosity of the head sparse, the fontanelle with two pairs of hairs, hairs between the fontanelle and the antennal sockets, the labrum with apical and subapical hairs, the disc hairs generally visible as two pairs, the pronotum rather sparsely haired. The oval head rather narrow and long, longer than its greatest width, widest near the middle, the middle of the posterior margin slightly projecting, the middle of the dorsal margin slightly concave in profile, the postmentum projecting rather downwards; the inner margin of the fontanelle aperture nearly triangular, its height slightly less than its width, the top slightly inclined backwards in profile; the tips of the mandibles curved inwards with the curved end extending rather long, the base of the outer margin slightly projecting; labrum long spear-shaped, widest near the posterior part, the transparent area small and obtusely triangular; antennae with 16 segments, the second larger than the fourth, the third shortest; postmentum narrow and long, the oblique margin before the widest part nearly straight, the waist rather narrow with its narrowest part posterior. The pronotum rather narrow, broader at the anterior part of both sides, the median notch of the anterior margin deep and wide, the median notch of the posterior margin shallow and narrow. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2. The circular head is distinctly broader, its width only slightly less than the length of the head, the posterior margin nearly round, widest at the middle, the middle of the dorsal margin arcuate in profile, the anterior part of the postmentum rather low and flat, the middle rather raised and slightly inclined backwards, the waist rather narrow with its narrowest part posterior, the labrum slightly broad and spear-shaped, the rest similar to the oval form.
